flowContents.name: Tuan - dong bo analytics_db
flowContents.comments: W5: visits, feedbacks (1 phut); artifacts, heritage_sites, users (5 phut) -> analytics_db

properties.db-fetch-sql-query: SELECT id AS user_id, COALESCE(preferred_language, 'vi') AS language_code FROM users
SELECT id AS visit_id, user_id, artifact_id, detected_at, duration_seconds FROM visits
SELECT id AS feedback_id, artifact_id, rating, status, created_at, updated_at FROM feedbacks
SELECT id AS site_id, name, location, latitude, longitude FROM heritage_sites
SELECT id AS artifact_id, artifact_code AS code, name, site_id FROM artifacts

parameters.name: db_user
parameters.description: Tạm dùng root; đổi sang user analytics khi Tường tạo xong

parameters.name: users_db_url
parameters.description: Nguon users: auth-service tuan 5 van dung smart_heritage_db; khi chuyen sang auth_db thi doi ten DB o day

parameters.name: personalization_db_url
parameters.description: Nguon visits (Phu). Tam thoi neu personalization-service chua tach thi doi sang smart_heritage_db
